status: Appearance proposals only; no selection or integration

entries.label: A · Cristaux corrompus
entries.prompt: SUBJECT A: a compact asymmetrical growth of THREE violet crystals emerging naturally from a very low piece of dark fractured slate. One main leaning crystal and two short companions of clearly different heights. Chunky tapered faceted silhouettes, deep purple sides, a few lavender facets, subtle core brightness but no white-hot shine and no broad glow. A few dark root-like ridges wrap the rock near the base. Overall footprint about .30 cell, height .28 cell; wider at the base than the tiny companions. Low and natural, not a symmetrical crown, no crystal pedestal or gem jewellery.

entries.label: B · Idole de pierre
entries.prompt: SUBJECT B: a squat ancient malevolent stone idol, a single heavy carved object with a broad head, short fused body and very low square foot. Abstract horned guardian face: TWO short swept-back broken-looking horn shapes, a strong brow and two narrow recessed violet eyes, angular closed mouth. Stylized inanimate stone sculpture, not a living monster, no limbs sticking out. Large simple carved planes with softened edges. Dark slate-blue stone matching dungeon walls, slightly worn, one restrained cheek fissure. Small dim violet eyes, no full-object glow. Footprint around .30 cell, height .40 cell. Keep silhouette bold, concise and recognisable at small size. Avoid intricate head ornament, tall pedestal, cartoon skull and gold.

entries.label: C · Stèle rituelle
entries.description: Une pierre dressée, une seule rune
entries.prompt: SUBJECT C: a small upright ritual stele of dark slate-blue stone with a wide stable wedge-shaped foot and a subtly pointed clipped top. Thick, physically sculpted slab, shown in the current isometric view so its front carving and side thickness are visible. One large recessed angular occult seal with three simple interlocking strokes (abstract invented geometry, NOT writing), faint violet light deep inside the carving. One chipped upper corner and a few broad bevels. Compact upright silhouette about .25 cell wide and .48 cell tall; not a towering obelisk. Upper-left bevels quiet, face mostly dark and calm. No repeated diamond emblem, tiny runes, chains, floating fragments or attached torches.

entries.label: D · Vasque d’offrandes
entries.prompt: SUBJECT D: a low wide ritual offering bowl, heavy charcoal iron with a thick softly scalloped rim, seated on three short chunky feet. A very shallow pool of muted violet magical liquid inside the visible elliptical mouth, with one broad soft swirl and a darker centre; NOT a portal or vortex. Two small horn-like rim grips, simple robust forging. The mouth is a horizontal ellipse in 2:1 isometric perspective. Bowl cavity distinctly visible, sides dark. Overall diameter about .35 cell, height .18 cell. Tiny reflected purple light on INNER rim only, no steam, flame, pouring liquid, particles, decorative plinth or light splashing onto the ground. Minimal readable detail.

entries.label: E · Grimoire scellé
entries.description: Un accent de cuir et de métal
entries.prompt: SUBJECT E: one closed thick sinister grimoire resting flat on a low dark stone book rest, with its top cover clearly visible in the 2:1 ground-plane projection. Muted burgundy/plum leather, chunky charcoal iron corner guards, thick cream-grey page block and one heavy iron clasp with a small dull violet inset stone. A single diagonal leather strap across the cover. The stone book rest is very low and simple, not a lectern or altar. Strong rectangular book silhouette, roughly .34 by .25 cell footprint and .14 cell height. No letters, tiny inscriptions, skull ornament, glowing pages, chains scattered on the floor, gold trim or spell particles. More crafted than a plain block but readable at tiny size.

entries.label: F · Cierges rituels
entries.description: Une petite touche de lumière chaude
entries.prompt: SUBJECT F: one compact group of THREE thick ritual candles of different heights, joined by pooled dark plum wax on a small black iron saucer. One tall candle, one medium, one short arranged asymmetrically and all clearly visible. Each flame is a simple compact amber-orange teardrop with a round seated base attached to the wick, no oversized plume; warm highlights only on the top rims and nearby wax. Two broad wax drips per candle at most. Chunky readable grouped silhouette, the tallest about .35 cell high, footprint .28 cell. Bottom saucer horizontal and shown as a 2:1 ellipse. No tall metal candelabrum, no skulls, floating sparks, giant halos or ground shadow. Must feel like a ritual object in an evil dungeon, not a colourful party candle.

sourcePolicy: Preserve all original pixels and native alpha. Alpha128 measures subject height only; crop alpha-zero margins and resize uniformly. No stretching, recolouring or background removal.
limitations: The guide validates the review ground grid, not exact source prop geometry. AI camera correspondence still needs fitted support verification.
Contact anchors are provisional; no baked or procedural shadow/light is added to these review montages.
Production atlas, scripts, scenes and camera unchanged; no Godot import/export, automated tests, commit or push.
